Name: Sir Robert's Plant Catalog
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial][b]Description[/b][/font][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]This collection contains all of the houseplants from my previously published mods into one large catalog. With this all-in-one mod, you will have a much easier time finding the houseplant of your dreams and creating a peaceful oasis for your home in Stardew Valley. All of the images will automatically appear in the Decor Section of the furniture catalog or Happy Home Designer.[/font][/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]If you are like me and want as many houseplants as possible in a well-organized format, please download Sir Robert's Plant Catalog and delete my other mods. (Remember to remove any of my old houseplants from your house in Stardew Valley; otherwise you'll get those pesky red error symbols on your screen).[/font][/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]My other mods are still available to download for those who prefer to have a smaller selection of plants and flowers. Please use whichever mod is best for you and happy decorating![/font][/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial][b]Installation instructions[/b][/font][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/font][/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial][b]Main features[/b][/font][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]This mod features 32 plants; each image has a variety of colors and pots to choose from via Alternative Textures. Some images only have a few Alternative Textures and others may have 20 or more. It all depends on whether there are a lot of color options and pots available.[/font][/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]Please note: they should all fit perfectly on most end tables. Due to the large number of plants, I didn't include any to fit upon kitchen counters. [/font][/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial][b]Requirements[/b][/font][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]Requires the Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. I recommend using Happy Home Designer. Also, I suggest using Precise Furniture to move any of the large potted plants on the floor. This way you can move them pixel-by-pixel and it will make decorating a lot easier.[/font][/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial][b]Shout outs[/b][/font][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][font=Arial]The end tables in the pictures are from mods made by Platinum Cats, lululovely and HimeTarts & Wildflour. I also used end tables from the Stardew Valley furniture catalog. Some of the plants are from the furniture catalog, which I tastefully recolored and put into new pots. I also used plants from my own design.[/font][/size][/color]
